items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind inherited receipts to the full parent SHA**

When a PR author creates an update-branch merge whose first parent was never audited, they can grind that parent’s commit until its seven-character prefix matches an older audit for the same task. This lookup then loads the older receipt, while the patch-id and merge-tree checks only compare the new merge with its actual first parent and never verify that the receipt audited that parent, allowing an unrelated audit to be inherited. Store and verify the full audited commit SHA before reusing a receipt.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L75-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/eeaa196201308f1edf3ed021b8450fb3a63c7e07/AGENTS.md#L75-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
